customManagers.description: The Terrakube version pull requests run the acceptance tests against.

packageRules.description: chore(deps) stays out of the changelog and does not cut a release. Retitle a security update to fix(deps) before merging it.
One pull request for the Terraform plugin libraries, which are released together.
A new tfplugindocs changes the generated docs, and Renovate cannot run go generate. Tick it in the dependency dashboard to get the pull request, then regenerate docs/ on it.
Images of the acceptance test Terrakube (scripts/acceptance), pinned to exact tags. The Terrakube version is the one the compatibility guide lists.
prBodyNotes: If this moves Terrakube to a new minor, update `templates/guides/compatibility.md` in this pull request.
